system.description:
ENCHANTMENT MENTAL SAVE

Tradition ethereal; Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal); Range 30 feet; Targets 1 living creature; Saving Throw Will; Duration Sustained (1 minute)

You rouse the spirits of mischief in an attempt to disrupt your targets spells. Each time the target casts a spell they must make a saving throw:

Critical The creature is unaffected and the spell ends.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Partial The creature takes a -2-circumstance penalty to their spell check.

Failure The creature takes a -4-circumstance penalty to their spell check.

Fumble The creature takes a -10-circumstance penalty to their spell check.

Automated: the target is marked with your spell save DC (B8-4). Each time it casts a spell it saves Will, rolled for it before its spell check: Critical unaffected and Spiritual Distraction ends; Success unaffected; Partial −2, Failure −4, Fumble or Blunder −10 circumstance to that spell check.
